title: QAROS web app adaptations index
description: webapps-index.json, published with every qaros-webapps release at https://github.com/Quaternar/qaros-webapps/releases/latest/download/webapps-index.json. A reader refuses an indexFormatVersion it does not know. The signature covers SHA-256("QAROS-WEBAPPS-INDEX-SIGNATURE-V1" NUL canonical JSON of the index without "signature"), canonical meaning sorted keys, no whitespace, UTF-8.

indexFormatVersion.description: Layout of this file. Changes that old readers cannot ignore bump it.

repository.description: GitHub repository the release belongs to.

release.description: Tag of the release this index was published with.

adaptations.description: One entry per adaptation, sorted by id.

signature.description: Signature of the index by the QAROS release key. Present in every published release.

version.description: Semantic version major.minor.patch with an optional -prerelease.

id.description: Adaptation Id from its profile.json (reverse DNS).

name.description: Adaptation Name (its folder in the repository).

asset.description: File name of the package in the release: <id>-<version>.qarapp.

release.description: Tag of the release holding the package.

sha256.description: Lower-case hex SHA-256 of the package file.

size.description: Size of the package file in bytes.

minQarosVersion.description: Oldest QAROS version that installs this adaptation.

signed.description: Whether the package's profile.json carries a signature.

keyId.description: Lower-case hex SHA-256 of the DER SubjectPublicKeyInfo.
